# AGENTS.md — epic membership stub

This repo sits under an epic-tree root: the nearest ancestor directory that has an
`epics/` folder (usually one level up). Codex/Copilot-family tools stop AGENTS.md
discovery at this repo's git root and never see the root-level adapter — this stub
bridges that gap. Before ANY work here read, relative to that root:

1. `AGENTS.md` — the full epic adapter; its rules are binding here.
2. `epics/<slug>/charter.md` of the epic your task names — the Non-negotiables
   section, verbatim. If the task names no epic, ask; never guess one.
3. `epics/<slug>/state.md` — where the work stands.

This file is intentionally untracked (listed in `.git/info/exclude`) and is
removed when no live epic remains under the root.
